Agent: Hello, this is Guardian, an AI assistant calling on behalf of Dr. Lee. Am I speaking with Maria Gomez?
Patient: Yes, speaking.
Agent: On our last call your blood pressure was 158 over 95. Did you take your blood pressure today?
Patient: No, I haven't measured it yet today.
Agent: No problem. Please measure it after our call, and I will call you back in 15 minutes to record it. Did you check your blood sugar?
Patient: Yes, this morning it was 126.
Agent: Did you take your medication today, and at what time?
Patient: Yes, at 8 o'clock with breakfast.
Agent: Are you having any chest pain, trouble breathing, or severe dizziness right now?
Patient: No, none of that.
Agent: Thank you, Maria. I will call you back in 15 minutes for your blood pressure.
